text:
ana: Quick heads-up: planning a coordinated base-image refresh + RBAC tighten + cosign/KMS key rotation next Wed 03:00 UTC. Need a short checklist and blast-radius mitigation plan.

siva: Scope? full fleet or just prod/canary first? Node drain plan?

ana (typo)

ana: sorry, ana. Plan is canary (10% nodes in canary cluster) -> staging -> prod. We'll gate via a PR that toggles namespaces. We'll remove cluster-wide secret read on the image-pull service-account and require registry-signed images.

marta: For KMS rotation: we should dual-sign images for 24h and keep old key version enabled for 48h in case rollback is needed. Add an audit marker event when the alias switches so SOC filter rules don't spam. Recommend registry/audit log retention of 180d for the migration window.

jordan: Runtime gotchas: older nodes may rely on node-level imagePullSecrets or in-tree credential helpers. If SA loses read access, pods with long-lived mounts or stateful workloads may fail on restart. Plan rolling restarts and watch pod lifecycle events.

lee: Two small asks: 1) add a healthcheck job that pulls a sample image and runs `cosign verify` on it every 5m during cutover; 2) export a list of images that are pinned (sha) vs tags so we can triage failures faster.

ana: Example commands for the runbook: 

```
# drain a canary node, restart pullers, validate image signature
kubectl cordon node-canary-01
kubectl drain node-canary-01 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
kubectl rollout restart daemonset/image-puller -n infra
cosign verify --key ksm://projects/prod/locations/global/keyRings/cosign/cryptoKeys/key gcr.io/redwood/app@sha256:abcdef1234
# quick KMS state check
gcloud kms keys versions list projects/prod/locations/global/keyRings/cosign/cryptoKeys/key
```

marta: Post-cutover checks: 
- sample 50 images across registries: `cosign verify` success
- registry audit contains key-rotation marker and both signer aliases for dual-sign period
- SBOMs/attestations still link to signed manifests
- no spike in image_pull_failures or runtime_authz_denials

sec-bot: [automated] KMS alias rotation scheduled for 2026-04-01T03:00:00Z. Open PR for signer-role updates and RBAC flag toggles required.

siva: I'll own oncall for the window. Rollback knobs: 
- re-enable previous KMS key alias (we'll keep the key version active)
- revert RBAC via CI feature flag
- re-tag images to previous dual-signed tag if verification rejects

jordan: I'll add ephemeral dashboards and alerts: image_pull_fail_rate (1m), runtime_authz_denials (2m), cosign_verify_failures (5m). Also add a runbook snippet: `kubectl get events --field-selector reason=Failed` | grep -i pull OR cosign.

marta: Also prepare an incident template: 
1) Confirm cosign verify fails -> run `cosign verify` and `gcloud kms keys versions list`
2) Check registry audit log for signer alias and timestamp markers
3) Check node logs for image pull credential errors (`journalctl -u containerd` / kubelet errors)
4) If node-level pull secrets missing, temp fix: apply projected service account token or re-create imagePullSecret on node bootstrap.

lee: Reminder: some infra tooling (image pruner, scanner) authenticates via a robot token with clusterrole secrets get. Changing SA perms might break them; we should list robot accounts and update their bindings.

ana: Good catch. I'll include robot account inventory in the PR and add a preflight: `kubectl auth can-i get secrets --as=<robot-sa>` for all listed bots.

marta: Dry-run: run cosign verify sweep against staging registry to catch manifest-shim issues we saw previously (manifest v2 vs OCI layout differences).

ana: I'll open the PR with: staged namespace list, canary schedule, audit retention request, the rollback knobs, runbook snippets, and links to dashboards. Tagging @siva @marta @jordan @lee for review. :thumbsup:

siva: ack, will review today.

marta: leaving a note: enable verbose cosign debug during the migration window to capture pull/verify errors in detail.

ana: thanks all. We'll reconvene 1 hour before the window for preflight.
